channel.title: MicroPython Boards (micro:bit, Pico, ESP32, Arduino) :: Coursebook Informatics
channel.description: MicroPython is Python for small computers without screen or keyboard, so-called microcontrollers. You write the same Python code as on the PC (if, while, functions, lists), plus modules such as machine or microbit that control pins, LEDs and sensors. You program in Thonny, the board is connected to the PC via USB. You need this page from P1 week 3. No board at hand? The same code runs in the Wokwi simulator.
